data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, I'd recommend **Stripe as the best all-round payment processor**, particularly if you're starting out and want something reliable, easy to integrate and reasonably priced.

However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how many sales you expect and whether you want to accept PayPal as well as card payments.

Here are the main options I'd consider.

## Best payment processors compared

| Processor | Best for | UK online card fees |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Best overall for online stores | 1.5% + 20p |
| Square | Online and physical sales | 1.4% + 25p |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | Depends on plan |
| PayPal | Customer familiarity and PayPal checkout | 2.9% + fixed fee |


Fees are standard advertised UK rates; international and premium cards can cost more. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[squareup.com](https://squareup.com/gb/en/legal/general/fees?country_redirection=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paypal.com](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/stripe-vs-shopify-payments/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendations

**1\. Stripe – best overall**

(My first choice)

- No monthly fee on standard pricing.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and many other platforms.
- Accepts cards and digital wallets.
- Supports subscriptions and recurring payments.
- Good reporting and fraud protection.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

**2\. Square – best for online and in-person sales**

- Useful if you also sell at markets, events or a physical shop.
- Online checkout and physical card readers.
- Straightforward pricing.
- Good sales management tools.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

**3\. Shopify Payments – best if you use Shopify**

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Convenient order and payment management.
- Avoids the additional third-party transaction fee Shopify may charge when using an external processor.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

**4\. PayPal – best as an additional payment option**

I'd consider offering PayPal alongside your main card processor rather than using it exclusively. Some customers prefer paying with their PayPal account.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

## What I'd actually choose

For a new or growing online store\:

- **WooCommerce\:** Stripe.
- **Shopify\:** Shopify Payments, with PayPal as an additional option.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Online store plus physical shop\:** Square.

I wouldn't necessarily choose the processor with the lowest headline fee. Reliability, checkout experience, compatibility and customer payment preferences can make a bigger difference to profitability.
